caption: A duck paddles across a calm pond, and its reflection glides along under it, breaking up in the wake it leaves.

sa.check: A duck paddles across a pond.
Its reflection glides along under it.
The reflection breaks up in the wake it leaves.

pc.expect: The reflection stays directly beneath the duck and moves with it, wavering in the ripples behind.
pc.fail: It is offset from the duck; or stays still while the duck paddles; or it is sharp in the wake and broken ahead.

pc.expect: The reflection is inverted and joined at the waterline.
pc.fail: It is upright; or detached from the duck; or a different bird.

pc.expect: The reflection does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It moves with the duck still; or drifts across the pond.

pc.expect: The water is liquid: ripples spread from the duck and the surface ahead stays flat.
pc.fail: The surface is rigid; or ripples run ahead of the duck; or the water flows uphill.

pc.expect: One duck and one reflection; the reflection stays on the water.
pc.fail: A second duck appears; or the reflection rises off the water; or the duck vanishes; or the reflection becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The duck's plumage and the pond stay the same.
pc.fail: The plumage changes; or the pond changes colour; or the shore rearranges.

note: Self-driven animal: where it goes and how it moves are not judged. Only the reflection's relation to it is.
